name: Article 21, § 11 – 231
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 11. Where rescEU capacities consist of equipment or consumable goods, the Commission, through the ERCC, and in consultation with the requesting Member State and the Member State hosting the response capacity, may decide to either donate or loan the offered rescEU capacities based on identified needs.
